_comment: A badge is earned when EVERY listed stat reaches its number. Stats: prs (merged PRs that solved something), points, sinks (engine blind spots removed), cleared (challenges taken to zero), hard_cleared (hard ones among them), languages (distinct languages fixed in). Edit the numbers freely; badges are recomputed from the ledger on every run.

badges.name: First Light
badges.description: First merged fix for an engine challenge

badges.name: Clean Sweep
badges.description: Took 3 challenges all the way to zero

badges.name: Polyglot
badges.description: Fixed the engine in 3 different languages

badges.name: Core Contributor
badges.description: 5 merged fixes and 50 points: you are shaping the engine
